overview_description.description:
100ms is a live-video infrastructure platform that provides subscription-based products to its customers. The company provides a low-code solution for companies looking to add video/audio conferencing within their own applications. To bring real-life interactions to the virtual world seamlessly
The increasingly virtual, remote-first world, needs an infrastructure provider that allows these experiences to happen seamlessly. 100ms' best-in-class quality and ease of use are fueling this revolution.
Making live video work - our team has been obsessed with this problem for years and solved it at world-class scales for different network and device conditions. A great infrastructure provider also needs to have the shortest integration time - so our foundation is built on the above two principles.

about_short_description.short_description: 100ms is a live-video infrastructure startup that allows developers to build and deploy enterprise-class video applications in hours.

product.name: 100ms Live Video SDK
product.description: A software development kit enabling developers to integrate live audio and video communication into applications with customizable features and scalable infrastructure.

product.name: 100ms Interactive Live Streaming SDK
product.description: An SDK that combines real-time video call interactivity with scalable live streaming to millions of viewers using HLS protocol.

product.name: 100ms Prebuilt UI Components
product.description: Open-source UI components that provide ready-made interfaces for live audio-video experiences, simplifying integration and customization.

product.name: 100ms Workspaces and Teams Management
product.description: A dashboard feature enabling isolated deployment environments and team collaboration with role-based access control for managing live video projects.

product.name: 100ms Cloud Video Infrastructure
product.description: Cloud-based infrastructure that supports scalable, low-latency live video communication and streaming with high uptime and network adaptability.
